detail.caption: Figure 40.3. The two disjoint cutoff regions fold into the exact coefficient TU+TYT_U+T_Y, followed by the physical cubic matrix on coprime good squarefree ideal factors. Norm axes are schematic, not ideal counts; a common prime gives a raw zero. The displayed tail is the normalized Gauss moment, not an energy or the raw numerator. The bound uses the explicitly cited external cubic sieve. At U≥D1/8U\ge D^{1/8} the choice Y=D1/8Y=D^{1/8} fits the stated pure critical error budget; if Y=UY=U the coefficient tail is zero. The small-cutoff moment and the full kernel remain open.
